event.title: Microsoft Faces Global Outage of 365 Services, Impacting Users Worldwide
event.canonical_title: Microsoft Faces Global Outage of 365 Services, Impacting Users Worldwide
event.summary: Microsoft is currently dealing with a significant outage affecting its 365 services, including Outlook, which has disrupted operations for users in 74 countries. The company is actively working on repairs but has reported that efforts are not progressing as expected, prompting them to explore alternative solutions.
